digest.component_or_area: CLI reference and distribution contract generation
propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution artifacts must derive entirely from runtime registries and committed parser help bytes, eliminating source regex parsing and hand-maintained command census.
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with exact byte-for-byte fidelity and no side effects from operation/config/store/handler imports.
All route classes, subcommand coverage, and exit-code documentation must enumerate from registry policy sets rather than reconstructed manual unions.
Editorial prose (examples and rationale) must be structurally separated, registry-linted for spelling validity, and never override generated syntax authority.
Every lazy handler/parser/selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping must be resolvable and validated without command execution in the full-extra contract.
The same portable repo-local CLI check commands must execute identically in local development and CI environments, including rebar-mcp as a separate entry point.
